friendly_name: Prune unlinked runs and Op-scoped glossary logs
purpose_context: doctor event-logs (#6610) keeps two local-tier families forever, both reported as Mission not found: run directories whose run-index entry was replaced or removed (the slug survives only in inputs.mission_slug), and Op-scoped glossary logs named profile-invocation-<id>.events.jsonl. An unlinked item is now judged on age once it is past keep_runs and max_age_days, while a recorded unknown Mission keeps its protection, an open Op's log and a live run stay protected by their owner state and their locks, and the preview keeps reporting exactly what --apply would delete (#6739).
purpose_tldr: Make doctor event-logs reclaim run directories and Op-scoped glossary logs that link to no Mission or Op it can find.
